metadata.name: Gulf of Mexico Sediment Core M78/1_181-3 Stable Isotope Data
metadata.description: Paleoceanographic dataset containing 219 depth-resolved stable isotope measurements (δ13C and δ18O) from Uvigerina spp. foraminifera in sediment core M78/1_181-3, collected from the northern Gulf of Mexico at 29.0°N, 88.33°W and a depth of 803.5 meters. The data spans the last ~42,000 years (0.45 to 42.46 ka BP) and includes sediment depth, age estimates, and collection metadata.
metadata.temporal: Depth-resolved (0.03 to 12.18 m sediment depth); Age resolution varies non-linearly from ~0.45 to 42.46 thousand years BP
